reason: An OAuth integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that connects supported coding subscriptions, exposes their models, optionally reads local CLI credentials with explicit pull, and can provide a loopback-compatible API gateway.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Grok、Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code 和 Google Antigravity 等编码订阅的 OAuth 登录、模型路由及可选本地 API 网关。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Grok, Codex, Kimi Code, Claude Code, and Google Antigravity coding subscriptions through OAuth, model routing, and an optional local API gateway.

capabilities: OAuth sign-in and token refresh for supported coding-subscription providers
Routes model requests through Grok Build, Codex, Kimi Code, Claude Code, and Google Antigravity
Reads allowlisted local CLI OAuth files and performs explicit one-way credential pulls
Provides an optional loopback OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API gateway
Optionally enables search, usage, image, image-editing, and video capabilities
